plans.text: Use Backblaze as the cloud backup service.
Check out the electronics store near the user's place for tools and accessories.
Set up automatic backups for working files.
Open up the laptop to clean the fans soon.
Use an Anker cable organizer in the computer bag.
Reset the mouse using the manufacturer's instructions.
Update the mouse drivers if resetting it does not resolve the issue.

superseded_plans.text: Use Google Drive as the cloud backup service.
Pick up a small screwdriver the next time the user is out.
Use the 100 GB Google Drive plan for working files.
